news.title: Talks on launch of clinical trial of Ebola vaccine in DRC advance, WHO says

news.summary: Young adults’ use of vapes and cannabis hit all-time highs last year, according to a new survey.

news.summary: The change could boost how much health insurers, and patients, pay for some care.

news.summary: The White House nods to use of addiction medications but moves away from other harm reduction strategies.

news.title: STAT+: Cancer patients face longer wait times to begin treatment, according to new study

news.summary: German researcher Georg Schett has made a name for himself as a pioneer in autoimmune disease treatment. Now he's co-founding his own company.

news.summary: Stopping statins in people over 75 at low risk for heart disease didn’t increase deaths, a new study finds.

news.summary: Antelope Recovery offers mental health treatment for criminal justice-involved teens. The latest funding will also be used to develop additional programming specific to the challenges these youth face.

news.summary: Startup Suvi Health developed an ambient AI platform for patients to close gaps at critical transition points and support the handoff between hospital care teams and patients and their families.

news.title: The biggest payer and provider trends from Q2

news.summary: The tool can process inbound referrals, confirm eligibility and match patients to best-suited providers, the startup says.

news.title: Healthcare CFOs face growing decision-making expectations. Many say they aren't ready
news.summary: Healthcare chief financial officers often say they are expected to be substantially involved in a broad range of enterprise decision-making, though many don’t believe they are appropriately equipped to contribute.

news.title: Claims data transparency empowers employers to act on affordability: survey
news.summary: Employers that have access to key data on their healthcare spending and costs are more likely to take steps to address affordability and pharmacy benefit transparency, a new survey shows.

news.title: CMS ends Medicaid, CHIP funding for gender-affirming care for minors
news.summary: The Trump administration has finalized a rule that would pull funding for gender-affirming care for minors from Medicaid and the Children's Health Insurance Program.

news.title: Hims & Hers posts $753M in Q2 revenue as it preps for push into peptide market
news.summary: Digital health and wellness company Hims & Hers is ready to tap into a multi-billion peptide market if U.S. regulators loosen restrictions on manufacturing.

news.title: AI clinical monitoring agent can deliver up to 82 times the ROI in oncology: report
news.summary: A new analysis from the Tufts Center for the Study of Drug Development (CSDD) found that an AI clinical monitoring agent can deliver an estimated 82-fold return on investment in phase 3 oncology trials.

news.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

news.title: After slimming down workforce, Aardvark scraps phase 3 trials as wait for next steps drags on
news.summary: Aardvark Therapeutics has confirmed it is walking away from recently terminated phase 3 trials, telling investors it has no plans to resume the studies “as previously designed” as it works to find a path forward for its stalled pipeline.

news.title: Samsung hearing aid features for its ear buds garner FDA clearance
news.summary: The FDA gave Samsung Electronics the go-ahead for the latest software features that allow its Galaxy Buds earphones to act as an OTC hearing aid that also allows users to diagnose their hearing.

news.summary: Definium Therapeutics’ LSD formula has gone two for two in its phase 3 program, notching a win in generalized anxiety disorder months after knocking a depression study out of the park.

news.title: Deerfield-backed Boulevard Bio embarks on ‘beautiful path to a cure’ with trio of immunology drugs
news.summary: Boulevard Bio has strolled out of stealth with $65 million in funding from Deerfield Management and three autoimmune disease candidates.

news.title: CytoDyn’s leronlimab reaffirms HIV potential after combo treatment eradicates virus in infant macaques
news.summary: CytoDyn's leronlimab may have struggled to secure approval as an HIV treatment, but research in infant primates has offered fresh hope for the CCR5-targeting antibody's ability to treat the virus.

news.title: Amgen lays groundwork for new R&D center in Hyderabad
news.summary: Amgen is expanding its footprint in India with an R&D center in Hyderabad, the latest by from the California company to boost its research facilities.

news.title: Epicrispr raises $90M to rewrite treatment of rare muscle disease
news.summary: Epicrispr Biotechnologies has raised $90 million in a series C round backed by investors including Sanofi Ventures, positioning the biotech to advance a pipeline of epigenetic medicines led by an early-phase facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy prospect.

news.title: Zydus’ Sentynl pens $475M deal for Mereo’s phase 3-ready rare genetic lung disease drug
news.summary: Sentynl Therapeutics has penned a deal potentially worth $475 million for the option to market Mereo BioPharma's phase 3-ready rare genetic respiratory disease drug in the U.S.

news.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Aura loses 20% of staffers; aTyr shrinks by 60%
news.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

news.title: Abbott teams with Google Health on AI-powered health insights app
news.summary: Two giants of their respective fields, Abbott and Google, are joining forces for a first-of-its-kind team-up that aims to build out a digital picture of people’s health.

papers.title: Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness
papers.summary: Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor. In real-world deployments, however, complex system prompts, safety guardrails, and structural constraints continuously force models off this nominal path, driving a divergence between benchmark scores and deployment performance. papers.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
papers.summary: After an older adult misses a medication dose, a software agent can send another reminder and an embodied agent can bring the medication. Yet neither explains whether the person forgot, is confused, has side effects, or deliberately refused, nor what support is appropriate. This reveals a structural gap in Agentic AI: Digital Agents primarily transform software states, while Embodied Agents transform physical states; neither makes a person's evolving state and agency the primary object of modeling, intervention, and evaluation. papers.title: SymDiag: Explainable Diagnosis for LLM Reasoning via Neuro-Symbolic Verification
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as data-driven reasoners, yet their chains-of-thought (CoT) can be unfaithful even when final answers are correct. Most existing ``verification'' signals are not diagnostic: answer matching observes only the outcome, LLM-as-judge provides subjective and non-verifiable critiques, and scalar rewards (e.g., PRMs/RMs) offer little insight into where a multi-step derivation fails.We propose SymDiag, a neuro-symbolic framework that reframes reasoning verification as structured failure diagnosis.
